_comment: The ten QLM-Bench quadruped tasks. instruction = the exact training prompt (the policy server picks the cached prompt embedding <prompt_root>/<id>/embedding.pt by it); entry_ee = the front-left foot target [m, body frame] the controller enters POLICY with (RAMBO's default command, where every training episode starts); task_profile_version = the QLM-Bench runtime profile reported at reset. Read by wam_go2/wam/tasks.py.

tasks.instruction: Push the box inside the outlined area.
Lift the basket by its handle.
Kick the ball through the goal.
Sweep the block into the outlined area.
Push against the fridge door until the door closes.
Push the oven door until the door closes.
Rotate the valve lever upward to the upright position.
Slide your foot into the drawer handle opening and pull the drawer outward.
Press down the lever handle, then push the door open.
